name: Camping Dr.Lauth
beschreibung: Camping Dr. Lauth in Ehrwald, Tirol, offers an idyllic natural setting with views of the Ötztaler Alpen. The campsite is located directly on the Ehrwalder Ache and is therefore ideal for water play and river walks. The atmosphere is relaxed and quiet, with plenty of space for tents and caravans. Guests can benefit from easy access to hiking trails and the nearby Ehrwalder See, which invites swimming and relaxation.
